Hands down some of the best Thai food in NYC 🇹🇭🔥 Every bite at VIV Thai is packed with bold flavor, spice, and street-food perfection. Trust us—you’ll be craving it again before you even leave. 🍜✨ #VIVThai #NYCEats #ThaiFoodLovers

My family clocked out by Times Square and we headed to VIV Thai Restaurant & Bar in Hell’s Kitchen. Warm neon, Thai accents, a polished bar vibe—stylish without trying too hard. ✨

What we ordered:
🍤 Yum Sam Grob — Crispy white fish and fish maw tossed with cashews, red onion, and cherry tomatoes; the chili-lime dressing brightens everything—crisp, clean, balanced.

🔥 Tom Yum Goong — Deep, aromatic broth with a tight sweet-sour-heat balance; fresh shrimp and oyster mushrooms. Poured over rice, it just works.

🥢 Moo Ping Nom Sod — Iberico pork skewers with a gentle char; tamarind sauce and crispy garlic lift the savory notes.

🐚 Pad Hoi Gaab — Atlantic razor clams in a savory chili sauce with Thai basil; briny-sweet, springy, and distinctive.

🥚 KAI TOON MOR FAI — Silky steamed-egg hotpot with minced pork, shrimp, and squid; a subtle tang keeps it delicate yet complex.

🥓 MOO GROB TOD PRIK GLEUA — Half-lean, half-fat crispy pork: shattering crackle, garlic-chili perfume, savory finish without the grease.

🍹 Cocktails held their own — the rose-forward drink was a standout—rounded florals with a clean finish; romance in a glass.

Dinner at VIV Thai was more than just a meal—it was an escape from the chaos outside. Every dish felt thoughtfully layered, every flavor well-orchestrated, and the cocktails sealed the evening with elegance. It’s that rare place that feels both elevated and comforting, surprising yet familiar. Walking out, I knew one thing for sure: I’ll be coming back. ✨

Only 8 Tables… and Every One Matters 👀🍝
____
This small pasta shop in Denville, NJ only has eight tables and that’s exactly what makes it special. 

Cozy, intimate, and casual inside. No distractions, just well-executed food. Fresh pasta with rich, balanced sauces, tender meatballs, and garlic bread that was honestly top-tier. The cannolis stood out for me, too. Service was A1 from start to finish.

This is the kind of place you come to slow down, enjoy your meal, and actually taste your food.

Low-key room. Thoughtful plates.

📍 Denville, NJ
____

ICONIC NJ ITALIAN SPOT

The Pasta Shop in Denville, New Jersey in Morris County is one of the best meals I’ve ever had in NJ! This NJ restaurant makes fresh homemade pasta daily and is known for their famous meatballs and chicken parm. I think the mozz sticks should be famous as well because these are some of the best I ever had.
There’s no reservations so arrive early and put your name on the list, but trust me it’s soo worth the wait @the.pasta.shop and you have to end with their insane cannolis!!! This place is incredible, all you NJ foodies out there save this NJ spot

Have you stopped by The Pasta Shop yet? 🍝

“Our focus is Quality and Value. We are constantly seeking out new and better products, and continuing to evolve as a business. We’re not trying to be fancy — rather, we strive to be very consistent, and still have great seasonal specials to keep things interesting and fun.”

That’s the heart of The Pasta Shop — delicious, consistent food made with care and passion. Whether you’re grabbing a table or taking it to-go, you can always count on a meal that’s made with quality in mind.

Takeout is a huge part of what makes The Pasta Shop so loved — it keeps their incredible menu accessible even with limited seating in-store. So whether you’re craving comfort, flavor, or just your favorite pasta night in, they’ve got you covered. 💛

📍 Stop by or order takeout today — taste the difference for yourself!

latestPosts.caption:
LE BASQUE. NOV 15. By @chefguyvaknin and @cityrootsnyc 

Nestled in Union Square, Le Basque is an upscale vegan restaurant that masterfully blends the rich culinary traditions of France and Spain into a unique, plant-based dining experience. The name “Le Basque” pays homage to the Basque region, renowned for its vibrant cuisine that seamlessly marries the flavors of both countries.

Our team elevates plant-based cuisine with standout dishes like Faux Gras, Saffron Tuna Crudo, Port Beef Bourguignon, Seafood Paella, and the “Le Basque” Cheesecake. The bar features expertly curated French and Spanish wines, along with showstopping signature cocktails.

Le Basque welcomes you to a warm, sophisticated atmosphere designed by @studiorb.design. The highlight of the space is our mezzanine, where diners can enjoy a meal under an expansive full-ceiling skylight. Spacious yet intimate, it’s perfect for both romantic dinners and lively gatherings.

Reservations are available now. Limited seatings start November 15th. Experience the future of plant-based dining at Le Basque.
